SUMMARY: BookFactory builds a single procedural book (paperback or hardcover) with a paper block, wrapped covers, and applied surface/text materials plus optional wear. BookColumnFactory arranges many books standing upright leaning at angles in a shelf-like column; BookStackFactory stacks books flat with slight rotations. The upper-level file defines all geometry construction, dimension sampling, and layout logic; materials and low-level mesh helpers are pulled from infinigen infra. Note: the current code produces closed/upright books, not an open V-splayed accordion — achieving the requested open concertina fan would require new geometry logic here.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):
FILE: assets/objects/table_decorations/book.py

  BookFactory.__init__: per-book style, proportions, and material selection (all sampled at seed time).
    knobs: rel_scale(log_uniform(1,1.5)) -> overall book size multiplier; skewness(log_uniform(1.3,1.8)) -> height/width aspect ratio (taller vs squarer); unit(0.0127 fixed) -> quantization grid for width/height (imperial inch); is_paperback(uniform()<0.5) -> paperback vs hardcover branch; margin(uniform(0.005,0.01)) -> hardcover cover overhang past page block; offset(0 or log_uniform(0.002,0.008), 50/50) -> spine curvature/bulge depth of hardcover pages (set nonzero+larger for more arch); thickness(uniform(0.002,0.003)) -> hardcover shell solidify thickness; texture_shared(uniform()<0.2) -> whether front/back cover art is mirrored; scratch/edge_wear(prob & gens from material_assignments) -> optional surface wear overlays.

  BookFactory.create_asset: computes concrete dimensions and dispatches build.
    knobs: width(int(log_uniform(0.08,0.15)*rel_scale/unit)*unit) -> book width range; height(=width*skewness quantized) -> book height; depth(uniform(0.01,0.02)*rel_scale) -> book thickness (page-block depth); fn -> paperback vs hardcover path.

  BookFactory.make_paperback / make_paper: builds solid page block cube + trimmed cover cube (single-face cover).
    knobs: paper.scale insets (1e-4) -> tiny gap so cover shows; cover material via cover_surface; surface material (plaster) on pages.

  BookFactory.make_hardcover: builds arrayed cover strip wrapping spine with curvature.
    knobs: count(8 fixed) -> spine subdivision resolution (higher = smoother spine curve); relative_offset_displace(0,0,1) -> array direction; ratio-based x-=4*ratio*(1-ratio)*offset -> parabolic spine bulge shape (edit multiplier/exponent to change page arching); scale terms (width+margin)/2, height/2+margin, depth/2/count -> cover fit.

  BookFactory.make_cover: rotates book, applies wrap_front_back_side text/art texture.
    knobs: rotation_euler[0] (±pi/2 fixed) -> cover mapping orientation; texture_shared passthrough.

  BookColumnFactory.__init__/create_asset: upright leaning row of books.
    knobs: base_factories count(randint(1,4)) -> number of distinct book styles reused; n_books(randint(10,20)) -> books in column; max_angle(uniform(0,pi/9) 70% else 0) -> max lean/tilt of each book; per-book orientation flip(uniform()<0.5) -> lean direction; offset via longest_ray -> books packed touching along x.

  BookColumnFactory.create_placeholder: bounding box sizing (height=0.15*max_rel_scale*max_skewness).

  BookStackFactory.__init__/create_asset: horizontal stack of flat books.
    knobs: base_factories count(randint(1,4)); n_books(int(log_uniform(5,15))); max_angle(uniform(pi/9,pi/6) 70% else 0) -> random yaw jitter per stacked book; stacking offset from each book's top -> flush vertical piling; height cap in placeholder uses 0.02*max_rel_scale*0.8 per book.

  rotate(theta,x,y): 2D rotation helper for stack bounding-box corner computation.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> supplies wear_tear/wear_tear_prob generator lists.
  assets/materials/ceramic/plaster.py -> Plaster material for page block surface.
  assets/materials/text.py -> Text material generator for cover artwork/typography.
  assets/materials/art.py -> art/pattern shaders used by cover text material.
  assets/materials/wear_tear/edge_wear.py, scratches.py -> optional wear overlays.
  assets/utils/decorate.py -> read_co/write_co/write_attribute vertex ops.
  assets/utils/mesh.py -> longest_ray (collision spacing for column packing).
  assets/utils/object.py -> center, join_objects, new_bbox, new_cube primitives.
  assets/utils/uv.py -> wrap_front_back_side cover UV wrapping.
  core/surface.py -> assign_material and surface generation plumbing.
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class (seed, create_asset/placeholder API).
  core/placement/detail.py -> LOD/detail handling for placed assets.
  core/util/blender.py -> butil: ViewportMode, modify_mesh (ARRAY/SOLIDIFY), apply_transform.
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed for deterministic sampling.
  core/util/random.py -> log_uniform sampling helper.
  core/util/color.py -> color utilities for materials.
  core/nodes/* -> node graph construction backing procedural materials.
  core/tags.py -> semantic tagging of geometry.
  assets/materials/{metal,wood,fabric,plastic,plant,fluid,creature,terrain,dev}/__init__.py, lamp_shaders.py, utils/* -> material library registrations (indirect).
